description: slicers, Chromium 137+ (prototype: /bambu/2.09.02.62-9/ only): cross-origin isolated by Document-Isolation-Policy instead of COOP+COEP, so the tab keeps its opener and name and Boolean3d's Open in slicer can hand a file to the running tab (package/hand-over.js). Way back: disable the rule.
expression: (http.host eq "slicers.boolean3d.com") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bambu/2.09.02.62-9/")) and (any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"137\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"138\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"139\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"14") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"15") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"16") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"17") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"18") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"19"))
